objective: Redesign the next chart-ready trigger after v2 contract rejection. Return exactly three machine-checkable semantically distinct triggers using finalized adjusted daily OHLCV only. Each trigger must define one shared scalar state and an explicit threshold crossing of that same state from D-1 to D. Closed price-MA and price-above-prior/rolling-high semantics are forbidden even if algebraically renamed. Select exactly one rank-1 candidate. Do not write code, run experiments, invent acceptance thresholds, infer participant behavior, or claim profitability.
requiredOutputs: Exactly three PROPOSAL findings. Each claim must use exactly: CANDIDATE|featureId=<UPPER_SNAKE_ID>|family=<UPPER_SNAKE_FAMILY>|name=<short name>|state=<one scalar formula evaluated identically for each day>|prevTest=<exactly D-1 state <= threshold OR D-1 state >= threshold>|currTest=<exact opposite crossing on D>|fields=<OHLCV/derived inputs>|params=<bounded parameter family>|warmup=<minimum bars>|chart=<marker/overlay semantics>|densityRisk=<brief risk>|distinct=<why semantically independent from closed triggers>. Do not use pipe inside values.
The three featureId values and three family values must each be unique.
state must not contain D or D-1 labels; lag belongs only in prevTest/currTest.
Allowed transition pairs are only prevTest=D-1 state <= threshold with currTest=D state > threshold, or prevTest=D-1 state >= threshold with currTest=D state < threshold.
state may use OHLCV and deterministic rolling mean/range/location/gap/volume transforms, but may not encode close crossing/reclaiming a price MA or close crossing a prior/rolling high.
Summary must begin exactly RANK1|featureId=<one candidate>|reason=<only falsifiability, simplicity, chart traceability, or data availability rationale>.
nextActions must contain exactly one item: DISCOVERY_CONTRACT|featureId=<same rank-1>|parameterSearch=<bounded family>|notes=<implementation-independent notes>. Coordinator owns ranking and gates.
No market participant, institutional, catalyst, support/resistance narrative unless directly encoded in the scalar state; prefer mechanical language.
constraints: Treat P3_FEATURE_ARCHITECT_NEXT_TRIGGER_001_REJECTED and P3_FEATURE_ARCHITECT_NEXT_TRIGGER_002_REJECTED as binding negative evidence
No new data source, API, server, intraday feed, news, fundamentals, order book or broker state
No close-versus-prior-or-rolling-high trigger including algebraic equivalents
No closed trigger plus volume, volatility, MA ordering or context filter
Do not invent profitability or acceptance thresholds
Completed D and earlier information only; D+1 open remains executable entry reference
Do not run Discovery or Validation
